description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Ferry International is hiring a Jr. Web Developer to build, maintain, and optimize webpages and landing pages that support its brand, products, events, and marketing goals. The role collaborates with marketing and creative teams to develop engaging digital experiences, improve conversions, and manage web projects and assets.
Junior Web Developer building and maintaining responsive webpages and conversion-focused landing pages, creating digital assets, and using analytics to refine performance.

Responsibilities:
• Assist with the management and ongoing development of TomFerry.com
• Build clean, engaging, functional, and user-friendly webpages that support business goals and improve conversion
• Maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance existing webpages
• Create and test landing pages designed to improve user acquisition, retention, and return on investment
• Ensure webpages are responsive and provide a consistent experience across devices
• Partner with the Web Technology Manager and Marketing team to bring creative concepts to life
• Collaborate with graphic designers, copywriters, product marketers, and internal stakeholders on web projects
• Apply strong design principles while working within established brand guidelines and project requirements
• Create graphics and digital assets using tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma
• Understand digital design constraints and opportunities while offering creative solutions
• Use website analytics and performance metrics to guide design and development decisions
• Create and refine landing pages with conversion and ROI in mind
• Understand Google advertising graphic restrictions and apply those requirements when developing digital assets
• Review webpages and creative assets for accuracy, completeness, and quality
• Manage multiple projects and shifting deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail
• Produce creative assets efficiently and accurately
• Archive previous versions and project files according to established procedures
• Communicate progress, priorities, and potential challenges with the team
• Follow company policies, procedures, and brand standards while supporting departmental and company goals

Requirements:
• 1–3 years of similar or related experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
• A two-year college degree, specialized certification or licensing, specialized training, or job-specific skills acquired through an apprenticeship program
• Demonstrated knowledge of HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript
• Experience with content management systems, including WordPress
• Experience with responsive web design
• Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop and Illustrator, and Figma
• Understanding of UX/UI standards and web design principles
• Experience creating digital graphics, online banners, and email designs
• Ability to apply creativity while following established brand and design guidelines
• Familiarity with Google advertising graphic restrictions
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Preferred:
• Experience editing Shopify themes and templates using Liquid
• Familiarity with HubSpot, Shopify, and Salesforce
• Experience with animation and digital creative production
• Knowledge of email design and digital marketing platforms

Skills:
• 1–3 years of similar or related experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
• A two-year college degree, specialized certification or licensing, specialized training, or job-specific skills acquired through an apprenticeship program
• Demonstrated knowledge of HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript
• Experience with content management systems, including WordPress
• Experience with responsive web design

• Understanding of UX/UI standards and web design principles
• Experience creating digital graphics, online banners, and email designs
• Ability to apply creativity while following established brand and design guidelines
• Familiarity with Google advertising graphic restrictions
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
• Experience editing Shopify themes and templates using Liquid
• Familiarity with HubSpot, Shopify, and Salesforce
• Experience with animation and digital creative production
• Knowledge of email design and digital marketing platforms

Pay: $33/hr - $35/hr
